_about: Single source of truth for the gp_raw load. Maps each source sheet to a BigQuery table and each source column to a typed BigQuery column. Edit this file (not the generated schema JSON) when the lead answers D-02, D-03 or D-07, then run scripts/make_schemas.py.

Unique ID.name: unique_id
Unique ID.description: Donor identifier from the source export. Kept as text so prefixes and leading zeros survive.

ReceiptNo.name: receipt_no
ReceiptNo.description: Receipt number from the source export. Kept as text so leading zeros survive.

Address.name: address
Address.description: Postal address. Personal data: loaded only if include_address is true (RAID D-02).

Age.name: age
Age.description: Donor age in years. NULL when the source value is 0 (unknown) or outside the valid range; see age_status.

AGE.name: age
AGE.description: Donor age in years. NULL when the source value is 0 (unknown) or outside the valid range; see age_status.

Donation Amount (2019).name: donation_amount_2019
Donation Amount (2019).description: Total donated in calendar year 2019, in SGD (assumed currency; confirm).

Donation Amount (2020).name: donation_amount_2020
Donation Amount (2020).description: Total donated in calendar year 2020, in SGD (assumed currency; confirm).

Donation Amount (2021).name: donation_amount_2021
Donation Amount (2021).description: Total donated in calendar year 2021, in SGD (assumed currency; confirm).

Donation Amount (2022).name: donation_amount_2022
Donation Amount (2022).description: Total donated in calendar year 2022, in SGD (assumed currency; confirm).

Donation Amount (2023).name: donation_amount_2023
Donation Amount (2023).description: Total donated in calendar year 2023, in SGD (assumed currency; confirm).

Donation Amount (2024).name: donation_amount_2024
Donation Amount (2024).description: Total donated in calendar year 2024, in SGD (assumed currency; confirm).

Donation Amount (2025).name: donation_amount_2025
Donation Amount (2025).description: Total donated in calendar year 2025, in SGD (assumed currency; confirm).

Donation Amount (2026).name: donation_amount_2026
Donation Amount (2026).description: Total donated in calendar year 2026, in SGD (assumed currency; confirm).

age.name: age_raw
age.description: Age exactly as supplied, before validation. Kept so the age rule can change without a re-load.

age.name: age_status
age.description: valid | unknown (source value 0 or blank) | out_of_range (negative or above the valid maximum).

load_columns.name: _source_row
load_columns.description: Row number in the source sheet (header is row 1), for tracing a value back to the export.

load_columns.name: _load_id
load_columns.description: Load batch identifier; matches gp_audit.load_log.load_id and the landing-bucket folder.

tables.description: Normal donors, filtered copy. Identical to normal_donors apart from the ID prefix: load only one of the two into curated views (RAID D-07).
Normal donors 'without ...' (tab name truncated in the source; NDWN prefix). Meaning to confirm (RAID D-07).
Untitled tab 'Sheet1' (NDWA prefix, no Address column). Meaning to confirm (RAID D-07).
Donations made on behalf of deceased persons (filtered).
On-behalf donations without NRIC. 109 receipts also appear in onbehalf_without_address.
On-behalf donations without address. 109 receipts also appear in onbehalf_without_nric.
Anonymous donations, one aggregate row per year. Blank and empty duplicate header columns in the sheet are ignored.
